"Cops" is a short comedy,
starring Buster Keaton and featuring Joe Roberts, a star of Silent Hall of
Fame.  

The film is full of hilarious
moments and demonstrates Buster Keaton's extraordinary athletic abilities.

 "Cops" was added to
the National Film Registry in 1997 as being deemed "culturally,
historically, or aesthetically significant".
